Complemented by data from four nearby meridional IBe crossings of other POES spacecraft, this case study provides a novel quantitative information concerning the regular energy dependence of the loss\u2010cone filling ratio (Jprec\/Jtrap) variations near the IBe foot. Specific strong energy\u2010dependent difference of loss\u2010cone filling rates is manifested at different spacecraft and in various events in the same way, which is consistent with the pitch\u2010angle scattering in the magnetotail field reversal region as confirmed by the numerical simulation. Therefore it provides a landmark to distinguish the field line curvature scattering (FLCS) mechanism from wave\u2010induced precipitation.
